correctness.rationale: The block tree makes spanning trees a Cartesian product of single edge deletions, whose weight factors are inverse conductances. A vertex incident to at least two blocks retains degree at least two; only original leaves and degree-two vertices on a cycle contribute. Thus weighting and the discriminant test (also for monomials and linear factors) follow. For a mixed unit-weight cycle with a active-active and c inactive-inactive edges and r active runs, its middle coefficient is 2r; each of the c+r inactive vertices requires a distinct exterior vertex, by the block tree. Thus N≥a+2c+3r. If ac>0 and N≤6 only a=c=r=1 fits, giving discriminant zero. At N≤9, r=1 allows ac≤4 by checking c=1,2,3; r≥2 gives a+2c≤3 and ac≤1. Mixed patterns have 2r>0, so the factors have contiguous support and log-concavity survives convolution via order-two Toeplitz minors. The pentagon and octagon with two adjacent pendant attachments give, after shift and normalization, (1,2,2) and (1,2,5), proving the exact orders. The claim about missing terms in the local proof uses the actual attainable patterns, not arbitrary quadratics with an internal zero.
residual_risks: The universal cutoffs follow from the inequalities, not the reported atlas/pattern enumeration. The cutoff portion is restricted to unit weights.
